# Shailaputri v1 — anomaly detection across a server's metrics (SMD)

**SMD (Server Machine Dataset)** (NetManAIOps/OmniAnomaly @ `7fb0e0acf89e`): 28 real servers × 38 metrics, 708,420 labelled test minutes holding 327 anomalies. Each machine group (`machine-1`, `machine-2`, `machine-3`) is held out in turn; the model and every threshold are chosen on the other groups. Every detector is scored online by the same harness (`pashupatastra.evaluation.evaluate`) on exactly the same minutes.

Recall is per anomaly *episode*; precision is per flagged minute; false alarms are per 1000 minutes; lead is how many minutes before the anomaly's end the first flag came (higher is earlier). Not point-adjusted.

## How to read this

- *Onset-weighted* gives the first 20% of each labelled anomaly (at least 5 minutes) 5× the training weight. Compare its lead with the unweighted row to see whether that bought earlier flags, and its false alarms to see what it cost.
- *PCA per machine* is fitted on each machine's own unlabelled first half, so it has seen the held-out machines' normal behaviour; the learned model has not. That favours the baseline.
- Read F1 together with false alarms per 1000: a detector that flags everything catches every episode.
- Designed, written and trained by an AI assistant under the owner's direction ([adr/RealDataModels](../../adr/RealDataModels.md)).
